name: Proposal Agent (draft)
description: Deterministic proposal DRAFT generator: turns a Client Digital Company Map into the FusionTech proposal sections (executive summary, current problems, current technology, proposed architecture, CEO Brain modules, AI agents, CRM requirements, ERP/operations requirements, integrations, data onboarding plan, website requirements, automations, implementation phases, customer and FusionTech responsibilities, security, ongoing support). Pricing is never generated: it requires human approval.
triggered_by: Company Discovery Agent when discovery_complete (Discovery Console); the draft is appended to the Company Map note in the vault and a proposal_draft task (requires_approval) is created
